items.title: The ACT's 99-year leases are expiring — what does that mean for home owners?

children.content: The ACT is the only jurisdiction in Australia that operates under a leasehold system, meaning every home owner is actually a lessee. With the first of those leases coming up for renewal, there are questions about the leasing system's origin and ongoing relevance.
